stratagems.effect: Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Hunters
stratagems.when: Fight phase
stratagems.target: DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that hasn't fought this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each model's Pile-in or Consolidation move can be up to 6" instead of 3".

stratagems.name: Blood-fuelled Cruelty
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy ends a Fall Back move
stratagems.target: DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that started in Engagement Range of that enemy
stratagems.effect: Roll D6: 2-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, 6 deals 3 mortal wounds. Then the unit makes a Normal move, ending as close as possible to that enemy.

stratagems.name: Insanity’s Ire
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy that targeted your unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit this phase has shot
stratagems.target: That DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit
stratagems.effect: Your unit makes a surge move of up to D6".

rule.name: Power Matrix
rule.text: Your deployment zone is always in your Power Matrix. At the start of any phase, if you control at least half the objectives in No Man's Land, that area joins the matrix until phase end. The same applies to the opponent's deployment zone if you control at least half its objectives. CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if their unit is wholly within the matrix, they re-roll the Hit roll instead.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Sanctum
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. Models in the bearer's unit have Infiltrators.

enhancements.name: Hyperphasic Fulcrum
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. If the bearer leads a unit wholly within your Power Matrix, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks.

enhancements.name: Autodivinator
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. Each time your opponent gains CP from an ability, roll D6: on 2+ you also gain 1CP. (Does not trigger on army rules or discarding Secondary Missions.)

enhancements.name: Metalodermal Tesla Weave
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. Once per phase, when an enemy selects the bearer's unit as a charge target, roll D6: 2-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, 6 deals 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Curse of the Cryptek
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy unit shoots or fights
stratagems.target: A CRYPTEK model destroyed by that unit's attacks (usable after it dies)
stratagems.effect: Until end of battle, friendly CANOPTEK models attacking that unit add 1 to Hit and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Cynosure of Eradication
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.target: CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit wholly within your Power Matrix
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, its weapons have DEVASTATING WOUNDS.

stratagems.name: Solar Pulse
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase
stratagems.target: One CRYPTEK model
stratagems.effect: Select an objective within 18" of it. Until end of phase, NECRONS weapons have IGNORES COVER against targets within range of that objective.

stratagems.name: Reactive Subroutines
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move
stratagems.target: CANOPTEK unit within 8" of that enemy
stratagems.effect: That unit makes a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Countertemporal Shift
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: A targeted CANOPTEK unit
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, the unit can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18".

stratagems.name: Suboptimal Facade
stratagems.when: Opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy declares a charge
stratagems.target: A targeted CANOPTEK unit wholly within your Power Matrix
stratagems.effect: Its Reanimation Protocols activate.

rule.name: Worthy Foes
rule.text: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until your next Command phase, NOBLE, LYCHGUARD and TRIARCH units add 1 to Wound rolls for attacks against it.

enhancements.name: Honourable Combatant
enhancements.text: OVERLORD only. When the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, your opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

enhancements.name: Unflinching Will
enhancements.text: OVERLORD only. The bearer's melee weapons have PRECISION and ANTI-INFANTRY 5+.

enhancements.name: Warrior Noble
enhancements.text: OVERLORD only. Melee attacks targeting the bearer's unit subtract 1 from Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Eternal Conqueror
enhancements.text: OVERLORD only. Attacks by the bearer's unit against enemies within range of an objective can re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Your Time Is Nigh
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after your opponent's WARLORD is destroyed
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD
stratagems.effect: Until end of battle, enemy units subtract 1 from Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

stratagems.name: Enslaved Artifice
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit (excluding TITANIC) that hasn't shot or fought this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Nanoassembly Protocols
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: NECRONS VEHICLE unit targeted by those attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of each attack allocated to it.

stratagems.name: Sentinels of Eternity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit targeted by those attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, a destroyed model rolls D6: on 4+ it stays, fights after the attacker's unit finishes attacking, then is removed.

stratagems.name: Suffer No Rival
stratagems.when: Fight phase
stratagems.target: LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit that hasn't fought this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, melee weapons have PRECISION.

stratagems.name: Territorial Obsession
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control of its models (add 3 instead if it is a VEHICLE).

rule.name: Hyperphasing
rule.text: At the end of your opponent's turn, select NECRONS units not within Engagement Range of enemies: up to 1 unit (Incursion), 2 (Strike Force) or 3 (Onslaught). Remove them and place them in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Dimensional Overseer
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units you can select for Hyperphasing.

enhancements.name: Arisen Tyrant
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. Re-roll Hit rolls of 1. If the bearer's unit was set up this turn, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

enhancements.name: Hyperspatial Transfer Node
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. When the bearer's unit Advances, skip the Advance roll and add 6" to Move until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Osteoclave Fulcrum
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. Models in the bearer's unit have Deep Strike.

stratagems.name: Hyperphasic Recall
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy shoots or fights
stratagems.target: A NECRONS INFANTRY unit that lost models to those attacks, plus a friendly MONOLITH model
stratagems.effect: Remove the INFANTRY unit and set it up anywhere wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH and not in Engagement Range of enemies.

stratagems.name: Quantum Deflection
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: NECRONS VEHICLE unit targeted by those attacks
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, models in the unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Reanimation Crypts
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.target: Your NECRONS WARLORD
stratagems.effect: Each NECRONS unit in Reserves activates its Reanimation Protocols.

stratagems.name: Cosmic Precision
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER) arriving via ingress move this phase
stratagems.effect: Set it up anywhere more than 6" horizontally from all enemy models. It cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Dimensional Corridor
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit set up this turn via a MONOLITH's Eternity Gate, where that MONOLITH started the turn on the battlefield
stratagems.effect: The unit is eligible to charge this phase.

stratagems.name: Entropic Damping
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: A TITANIC model targeted by the attack and within 18" of the attacker
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, weapons of the attacking unit have HAZARDOUS.

rule.name: Relentless Onslaught
rule.text: NECRONS models (excluding MONSTER) add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks against units within range of an objective. Ranged weapons of NECRONS VEHICLE and MOUNTED models (excluding TITANIC) have ASSAULT.

enhancements.name: Dread Majesty (Aura)
enhancements.text: OVERLORD or CATACOMB COMMAND BARGE only. Within 6" of the bearer, friendly NECRONS units (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Miniaturised Nebuloscope
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. Ranged weapons of the bearer's unit have IGNORES COVER.

enhancements.name: Demanding Leader
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. In your Command phase, pick a VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC) within 6". Until your next Command phase, it can shoot in a turn it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Chrono-impedance Fields
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. In your Command phase, pick a VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC) within 6". Until your next Command phase, subtract 1 from Damage of attacks allocated to it.

stratagems.name: Merciless Reclamation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) that hasn't shot or fought this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for attacks against targets within range of an objective.

stratagems.name: Unyielding Forms
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC) targeted by those attacks
stratagems.effect: Subtract 1 from Wound rolls for attacks whose Strength exceeds the unit's Toughness.

stratagems.name: Chronoshift
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.target: VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC) that hasn't moved this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, if it Advances it skips the Advance roll and adds 6" to Move.

stratagems.name: Dimensional Tunnel
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.target: VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit (excluding TITANIC)
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, models can move horizontally through models and terrain features.

stratagems.name: Endless Servitude
stratagems.when: End of your Fight phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) within range of an objective you control
stratagems.effect: Its Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Reactive Reposition
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy shoots
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) targeted by those attacks
stratagems.effect: The unit makes a Normal move of up to D6".

rule.name: Technosorcerous Augmentations
rule.text: Ranged CRYPTEK weapons have ASSAULT. In your Shooting phase, when a CRYPTEK unit is selected to shoot, choose one of ANTI-INFANTRY 3+, ANTI-MOUNTED 4+, ASSAULT, HEAVY or IGNORES COVER for its ranged weapons until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Quantum Abacus
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. When you select the bearer's unit as a Stratagem target, roll D6 (+1 if within range of an objective): on 4+ gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Atomic Disintegrators
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. When choosing the Augmentations ability for the bearer's unit, you can also choose ANTI-MONSTER 5+ or ANTI-VEHICLE 5+.

enhancements.name: Gauntlet of Compression
enhancements.text: NECRONS only. Add 6" to the Range of ranged weapons of the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Gravitic Bolas
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. After the bearer shoots, pin one enemy unit it hit (excluding TITANIC) until your next turn. Pinned units subtract 2 from Move and 2 from Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Molecular Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit that hasn't shot or fought this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, ignore any modifiers to Ballistic/Weapon Skill and Hit rolls. CRYPTEK units can also ignore Wound roll modifiers.

stratagems.name: Microscarab Swarm
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit targeted by those attacks
stratagems.effect: NECRON WARRIORS get 5+ invulnerable saves; IMMORTALS get 4+ invulnerable saves, until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Animus Curse
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy shoots or fights
stratagems.target: A CRYPTEK model destroyed by those attacks (usable after it dies)
stratagems.effect: Until end of battle, friendly NECRONS models attacking that unit can re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Synergistic Empowerment
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase
stratagems.target: CRYPTEK unit
stratagems.effect: Pick a friendly NECRONS model (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in the unit. It gains the CRYPTEK keyword until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Untapped Power
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.target: CRYPTEK unit that hasn't shot this phase
stratagems.effect: When choosing a Technosorcerous Augmentations ability for it, you can choose one additional ability until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Potentiality Syphon
stratagems.when: Opponent's Command phase
stratagems.target: NECRONS unit within range of an objective
stratagems.effect: Its Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a CRYPTEK unit, it reanimates 1 extra wound.

rule.name: Cold Fervour
rule.text: DESTROYER CULT models add 2 to the Strength of their weapons. The first time each turn a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys a unit or drops it to Below Half-strength, friendly NECRONS (excluding DESTROYER CULT, MONSTER and TITANIC) add 2 to weapon Strength until end of turn.

enhancements.name: Destroyer Ankh
enhancements.text: CATACOMB COMMAND BARGE or OVERLORD only. Bearer gains DESTROYER CULT. Add 2" to the Move of the bearer's unit and add 2 to melee Attacks of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Murdermind
enhancements.text: CRYPTEK only. Bearer gains DESTROYER CULT and can attach to a DESTROYER CULT non-CHARACTER unit, which then cannot contain non-DESTROYER CULT models. Add 3" to the bearer's Move.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Nekrosor
enhancements.text: DESTROYER CULT only. Add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Cursed Circlet
enhancements.text: DESTROYER CULT only. In the opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit was destroyed by those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Methodical Murder
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE) not yet selected to shoot or fight this phase
stratagems.effect: Its weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Image of Death
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit that was targeted
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, each attack targeting your unit subtracts 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Mortis Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, after a DESTROYER CULT unit first destroys an enemy unit this turn
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit
stratagems.effect: That unit's Reanimation Protocols activate.

stratagems.name: Driven to Butchery
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Charge phase
stratagems.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit
stratagems.effect: Until end of turn, your unit can shoot and declare charges in a turn it Advanced. Once per turn.

stratagems.name: Spreading Madness
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE) that has not declared a charge this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, add 2 to its Charge rolls if a target is within Engagement Range of a friendly unit.

stratagems.name: Unnatural Aggression
stratagems.when: End of opponent's Charge phase
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE) within 6" of enemy units it could charge
stratagems.effect: It declares and resolves a charge only against those enemies. No Charge bonus this turn.

rule.name: Cosmic Distortion
rule.text: NECRONS MONSTER units have Distortion Fields (Aura): enemy units within 6" are unravelling, and attacks targeting unravelling units improve Armour Penetration by 1. At the start of each phase, a NECRONS MONSTER may suffer 3 mortal wounds to extend its aura to 9" until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Singularity Matrix
enhancements.text: C’TAN SHARD OF THE DECEIVER only. Lord of Deceit (Aura): once per turn, when the opponent targets a unit within 12" with a Stratagem, you can use this, increasing that Stratagem's CP cost by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Quantum Goad
enhancements.text: C’TAN SHARD OF THE NIGHTBRINGER only. It can declare a charge in a turn it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Animus Damper
enhancements.text: C’TAN SHARD OF THE VOID DRAGON only. Once per turn, at the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, select a visible enemy VEHICLE to take a Leadership test. Until end of phase, its attacks subtract 1 from Hit rolls, and also 1 from Wound rolls if the test failed.

enhancements.name: Reletavistic Tether
enhancements.text: TRANSCENDENT C’TAN only. When set up via Deep Strike or Transdimensional Displacement, it can be placed more than 6" horizontally from all enemies. If within 9" of an enemy, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Disharmonisation Cascade
stratagems.when: Any phase, after a NECRONS MONSTER is destroyed, before its Deadly Demise roll
stratagems.target: That MONSTER model (can be used though destroyed)
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, its Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds on a 3+ instead of a 6.

stratagems.name: Molecular Erosion
stratagems.when: Command phase
stratagems.target: One NECRONS MONSTER unit
stratagems.effect: Select one visible unravelling enemy; it takes a Battle-shock test at -1, and if failed suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. Once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Mass Transmogrification
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, after a MONSTER destroys an enemy unit
stratagems.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER) within 6" of that MONSTER
stratagems.effect: If the destroyed enemy was unravelling at phase start, that unit's Reanimation Protocols activate. Once per turn.

stratagems.name: Entrophasic Aura Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER) that has not shot or fought this phase
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, re-roll Hit rolls of 1; also re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against unravelling targets.

stratagems.name: Chronodistortion
stratagems.when: Fight phase, after an enemy selects targets
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit targeted by the attack
stratagems.effect: Until end of phase, destroyed models that have not fought may roll a D6 (+1 if attacker unravelling); on 4+, they fight later before removal.

stratagems.name: Phase Melding
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy Falls Back
stratagems.target: One NECRONS unit within Engagement Range of that enemy
stratagems.effect: Enemy models must take Desperate Escape tests; if Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from them.

rule.name: Hypermotility Protocols
rule.text: Friendly IMMORTALS and NECRON WARRIORS ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. Advancing with them does not stop them being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Enlivened Sentinels
enhancements.text: NECRON WARRIORS only. This unit has Scouts 5".

enhancements.name: Tools of Dominion
enhancements.text: IMMORTALS only. This unit's ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1].

stratagems.name: Dominance Protocols
stratagems.when: Command phase
stratagems.target: One friendly IMMORTALS unit
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Will of the Conqueror
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase
stratagems.target: One friendly IMMORTALS or NECRON WARRIORS unit
stratagems.effect: Select one objective it controls; that objective becomes secured.

stratagems.name: Nanosaturation
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy that targeted your unit has shot
stratagems.target: That IMMORTALS or NECRON WARRIORS unit
stratagems.effect: It shoots using snap shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.

rule.name: Transdimensional Deployment
rule.text: Friendly TOMB BLADES have Deep Strike. If a friendly TOMB BLADES unit made an ingress move this turn, its ranged attacks get +1 to Hit when it is selected to shoot.

enhancements.name: Recursive Reanimation
enhancements.text: TOMB BLADES only. When this unit activates Reanimation Protocols, add 1 to the roll.

enhancements.name: Deepening Madness
enhancements.text: DESTROYER CULT MOUNTED only. This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: Omnilocked Strafing
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit is selected to Fall Back
stratagems.target: That unit
stratagems.effect: Its fall-back move does not stop it being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Swift As Death
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit
stratagems.target: That unit
stratagems.effect: It can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Evasive Protocols
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets a friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit
stratagems.target: That unit
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks with Strength greater than its Toughness get -1 to Wound rolls.

rule.name: Empowered Engines
rule.text: Friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units have +6" Move.

enhancements.name: Mortality Shroud (Aura)
enhancements.text: OBELISK only. In the opponent's Battle-shock step, enemy units within 8" that are below Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Subsurface Quantumweave
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit
stratagems.target: That unit
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting it get -1 Armour Penetration until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Cosmic Storm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly OBELISK or TESSERACT VAULT is selected to shoot
stratagems.target: That unit
stratagems.effect: Its Tesla Sphere weapons get +1 Armour Penetration.

armyRules.name: Reanimation Protocols
armyRules.text: At the end of your Command phase, each friendly NECRONS unit on the battlefield with this ability activates it. When activated, that unit heals D3 wounds.
